# Usage

The commands `mt help` lists under Usage. More in [Plans and billing](../../../concepts/plans-and-billing.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`usage-breakdown`](#usage-breakdown) | Show a range's usage grouped by one dimension, such as namespace, definition, model or agent, largest first |
| [`usage-runs`](#usage-runs) | List the runs behind a range's usage, the most tokens first (or by runtime, execution or date) |
| [`usage-series`](#usage-series) | Show one usage measure over time, in hour, day or week buckets, optionally split by a dimension |
| [`usage-summary`](#usage-summary) | Show a range's usage totals (runs, tokens, runtime) beside the range before it, and by outcome |

## usage-breakdown

Show a range's usage grouped by one dimension, such as namespace, definition, model or agent, largest first.

```text
mt usage-breakdown [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--group-by, -g <value>` | text | yes |  | Group by: namespace, type, definition, version, agent, provider, model, engine, credentialKind, tier, outcome, startedBy, trigger or root |
| `--sort <value>` | text |  |  | Order by this measure, largest first: any usage-series `--metric` value (default: tokens) |
| `--limit, -l <number>` | whole number |  |  | How many groups to show before summing the rest as 'other', 1-500 (default: 50) |
| `--from <value>` | text |  |  | Start of the range, in ISO 8601, rounded down to the hour (default: 7 days before `--to`) |
| `--to <value>` | text |  |  | End of the range, in ISO 8601, rounded up to the hour; at most 400 days after `--from` (default: the next hour) |
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | Only these namespaces, by name (comma-separated; default: every namespace) |
| `--type <value>` | text |  |  | Only these run types: Interaction, App, Capsule or CodePipeline (comma-separated) |
| `--definition-id <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs of these definitions, by id (comma-separated) |
| `--version <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs of these definition versions, as &lt;definitionId>:&lt;version> (comma-separated) |
| `--agent <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage by these agents (comma-separated) |
| `--provider <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage of these AI providers (comma-separated) |
| `--model <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage of these AI models (comma-separated) |
| `--engine <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage of these code engines (comma-separated) |
| `--credential-kind <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage paid for with these keys: Own (yours), Platform (Maitento's) or Unknown (comma-separated) |
| `--tier <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage at these service tiers (comma-separated) |
| `--outcome <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs that ended this way: InProgress, Finished, Error or Killed (comma-separated) |
| `--started-by <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs started by a User, an Automation or a Parent run (comma-separated) |
| `--trigger-id <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs started by these users or automations, by id (comma-separated) |
| `--root-definition-id <value>` | text |  |  | Only what these definitions caused, their children included, by id (comma-separated) |

Filters combine: a run counts when it matches every filter given, and any one of a filter's comma-separated values. The value ~none matches runs that have no value for that filter. Usage covers the whole tenant unless `--namespace` narrows it.

## usage-runs

List the runs behind a range's usage, the most tokens first (or by runtime, execution or date).

```text
mt usage-runs [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--sort <value>` | text |  |  | Order by tokens, runtime, execution or date, largest or latest first (default: tokens) |
| `--limit, -l <number>` | whole number |  |  | How many runs to list, 1-200 (default: 50) |
| `--from <value>` | text |  |  | Start of the range, in ISO 8601, rounded down to the hour (default: 7 days before `--to`) |
| `--to <value>` | text |  |  | End of the range, in ISO 8601, rounded up to the hour; at most 400 days after `--from` (default: the next hour) |
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | Only these namespaces, by name (comma-separated; default: every namespace) |
| `--type <value>` | text |  |  | Only these run types: Interaction, App, Capsule or CodePipeline (comma-separated) |
| `--definition-id <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs of these definitions, by id (comma-separated) |
| `--version <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs of these definition versions, as &lt;definitionId>:&lt;version> (comma-separated) |
| `--agent <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage by these agents (comma-separated) |
| `--provider <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage of these AI providers (comma-separated) |
| `--model <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage of these AI models (comma-separated) |
| `--engine <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage of these code engines (comma-separated) |
| `--credential-kind <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage paid for with these keys: Own (yours), Platform (Maitento's) or Unknown (comma-separated) |
| `--tier <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage at these service tiers (comma-separated) |
| `--outcome <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs that ended this way: InProgress, Finished, Error or Killed (comma-separated) |
| `--started-by <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs started by a User, an Automation or a Parent run (comma-separated) |
| `--trigger-id <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs started by these users or automations, by id (comma-separated) |
| `--root-definition-id <value>` | text |  |  | Only what these definitions caused, their children included, by id (comma-separated) |

Filters combine: a run counts when it matches every filter given, and any one of a filter's comma-separated values. The value ~none matches runs that have no value for that filter. Usage covers the whole tenant unless `--namespace` narrows it.

## usage-series

Show one usage measure over time, in hour, day or week buckets, optionally split by a dimension.

```text
mt usage-series [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--metric, -m <value>` | text |  |  | What to measure: tokens, input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite, reasoning, runtime, execution, runs, steps, stepRuntime, toolCalls, webSearches, webPages, webDownloads, webCredits, webBytes or imageDescriptions (default: tokens) |
| `--bucket, -b <value>` | text |  |  | Bucket size: hour, day or week (default: hour up to 2 days, day up to 90 days, else week) |
| `--group-by, -g <value>` | text |  |  | Split by: namespace, type, definition, version, agent, provider, model, engine, credentialKind, tier, outcome, startedBy, trigger, root, or tokenType (with `--metric` tokens) |
| `--top <number>` | whole number |  |  | With `--group-by`, how many of the largest groups to show before 'other', 1-10 (default: 5) |
| `--from <value>` | text |  |  | Start of the range, in ISO 8601, rounded down to the hour (default: 7 days before `--to`) |
| `--to <value>` | text |  |  | End of the range, in ISO 8601, rounded up to the hour; at most 400 days after `--from` (default: the next hour) |
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | Only these namespaces, by name (comma-separated; default: every namespace) |
| `--type <value>` | text |  |  | Only these run types: Interaction, App, Capsule or CodePipeline (comma-separated) |
| `--definition-id <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs of these definitions, by id (comma-separated) |
| `--version <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs of these definition versions, as &lt;definitionId>:&lt;version> (comma-separated) |
| `--agent <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage by these agents (comma-separated) |
| `--provider <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage of these AI providers (comma-separated) |
| `--model <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage of these AI models (comma-separated) |
| `--engine <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage of these code engines (comma-separated) |
| `--credential-kind <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage paid for with these keys: Own (yours), Platform (Maitento's) or Unknown (comma-separated) |
| `--tier <value>` | text |  |  | Only usage at these service tiers (comma-separated) |
| `--outcome <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs that ended this way: InProgress, Finished, Error or Killed (comma-separated) |
| `--started-by <value>` | text |  |  | Only runs started by a User, an Automation or a Parent run (comma-separated) |

Filters combine: a run counts when it matches every filter given, and any one of a filter's comma-separated values. The value ~none matches runs that have no value for that filter. Usage covers the whole tenant unless `--namespace` narrows it.
